name: Power generation
description: Wellhead-platform power can be imported by subsea power cable from a host/CPP, generated locally by diesel or gas turbine, or supplied by a solar-PV/wind/battery hybrid with a standby diesel. Shell Timi (Malaysia) is the first SMEP wellhead platform fully powered by a solar-wind hybrid system; the Equinor patent describes a cascaded UPS/battery/black-start architecture for unmanned platforms.
aliases: Power generation (subsea cable from CPP; hybrid solar-wind with battery storage e.g. Shell Timi WHP)
